name: olai-plugin-omp
//name: UNSCOPED, like every other tenant: `@olai/*` is the scope for the packages that ARE olai, and an ENGINE is somebody else's agent with olai's judgement about it on top — the closest thing in this tree to a plugin written outside it. The directory is the plugin word (`omp`), which is the row's `id`, the settings namespace, and the address of its docs page.
//exports: FIVE, and the split is the tree's three-door rule with nothing added. `./server` is what the row mounts: the leg, the probe that looks for `omp` on the agent search path, and the install sentence — no `solid-js` anywhere on that graph. `./browser` is the chunk the tab fetches when the roster names this plugin, and it carries TWO things and only one of them is a face: the MARK this engine wears in a transcript's speaker column (a `<g>`, which is genuinely this plugin's drawing), and its INSTALL SENTENCE for the panel's no-agent face (a `NotHere` VALUE — core draws every stroke of that row and this package writes every word of it). The ROOT is the wire identity and nothing more — this plugin composes no sibling surface. `./testids` is the table this row contributes to the merged catalogue (empty, and that is a state), and `./all.css` is the stylesheet `@olai/bundle`'s generator points Tailwind at. `./testlib` is shared FIXTURES — the adapter frames the leg bench and the executable e2e fake both stage — and it is a door rather than a copy for the reason the other engines' are: two fakes that agree with each other about what a frame looks like are witnesses to nothing.
//: THE OH-MY-PI ENGINE — the leg that reads its wire, the probe that finds it on this host, and the mark it wears. The opencode shape in every structural respect: found rather than shipped, no pin, no adapter, no patches, no bridge — and its own MCP client, which is what makes the row one probe. What is NOT the opencode shape is inside the leg: this agent dispatches olai's MCP tools through its own `write` tool over an `xd://` pseudo-path, so the display reading and the reply reading are this file's own.
//dependencies: `@olai/acp/engine` is the shape both ends spell — the leg, the adapter, the registration — and it is a floor package under both this plugin and `olai-plugin-chat`, which is what lets neither import the other. `@olai/plugin-api` is the door: the `Agents` tag its `./server` registers into, and the slot service its `./browser` hangs a mark in. `effect` because a plugin's `apply` is one. `solid-js` because the mark is a component.
//devDependencies: The protocol SDK for `PermissionOption`, in the leg's OWN bench alone: the leg itself names none of the SDK's types (`@olai/acp/engine` carries the ones a leg's signatures need), and the fixtures that stage a permission request do. Type-only, so no SDK code and no zod enter this package's closure.
